description: My opponent has been telling voters that I won’t have enough time to serve in the State Senate because I’m a full-time working mother with two children. I think it’s worth asking why, in 2026, we’re still questioning whether a woman can lead because she’s also a mother.

title: My opponent says I don’t have the time to be a Senator. Here’s my answer.
